definitions.full: H7565. resheph I. רֶ֫שֶׁף noun masculine Hab 3:5 flame, fire-bolt ; — absolute ׳ר Deut 32:24 +; plural רְשָׁפִים Psa 78:48 , construct ׳רִשְׁפֵ 76:4 , רִשְׁמֵּי Song 8:6 ; suffix רְשֶׁפֶיהָ 8:6 ; — 1 flame: ׳ר ׳ר אֵשׁ Song 8:6 its flames (that is of קִנְאָה אַהֲבָה, ) are flames of fire ; ר ׳בְּנֵי Job 5:7 = sparks ; ׳ר = pointed flame of lighting Psa 78:48 (|| בָּרָד ); ׳ר קָ֑שֶׁת 76:4 Sharp flames of the bow , figurative for arrows. 2 fire-bolt of ׳יְ brining pestilence and death, Deut 32:24 (compare Dr; || מְרִירִי קֶטֶב ), Hab 3:5 (|| דֶּבֶר ).
